note: Saturated-pipeline day. Ten boolean search clusters run across LinkedIn (via Google/Bing index), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, ACC Jobline, FractionalJobs.io, Wellfound, and Built In, plus a direct read of the live FractionalJobs.io legal board. After deduplication against prior legal-freelance and pr-freelance reports and 100-point fit/intent scoring, no new posting cleared the 55+ include threshold. Nearly every live fund / fractional-GC posting surfaced this run was already captured (Latitude Legal, Ropes & Gray, aVenture, Allocate, Ontra, The Mom Project/Etsy, Socket, Lyfecoin, Fractionus, Roasa Law, CookUnity Healthcare Counsel, ACC Jobline #54004). One watchlist near-miss, held below threshold pending confirmation: ACC Jobline #53153 Commercial Contracts Attorney (In-House, Remote) scored 45 (fit 20 / intent 25) — engagement model (direct in-house vs. contract/interim) and recency were not confirmable because the ACC posting page is client-rendered and returned no body. This is expected diminishing-return behavior for a niche ICP scraped daily for 2+ months; no fabricated leads were added to hit a quota.
